import numpy as np

np.random.seed(42)
rolls = np.random.randint(1, 7, size=10000)

pmf = np.array([np.mean(rolls == i) for i in range(1, 7)])

expected_value = np.sum(np.arange(1, 7) * pmf)

theoretical_expected = (1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 6) / 6

expected_x_squared = np.sum(np.arange(1, 7)**2 * pmf)
variance = expected_x_squared - expected_value**2
theoretical_variance = 91/6 - (3.5)**2

expected_y = 2 * expected_value + 1
variance_y = 4 * variance

simulated_y = 2 * rolls + 1
simulated_E_y = np.mean(simulated_y)
simulated_Var_y = np.var(simulated_y)

print(f"Empirical PMF: {pmf}")
print(f"E[X] empirical: {expected_value:.4f}, theoretical: {theoretical_expected:.4f}")
print(f"Var(X) empirical: {variance:.4f}, theoretical: {theoretical_variance:.4f}")
print(f"E[Y] = {expected_y:.4f}, simulated: {simulated_E_y:.4f}")
print(f"Var(Y) = {variance_y:.4f}, simulated: {simulated_Var_y:.4f}")
